The execution failed due to missing schema keys and incorrect margin calculations in the final output.
The test_schema_and_assumptions failed because the 'assumptions' key was missing from the output data. Calculation errors were detected in test_rows_and_order, where a value of 3186.0 was found instead of the expected 1998.0. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed with a margin mismatch (-40694.83 vs -37130.83), and test_summary_requirements failed because formatted strings like '-42,908.83' were not found in the summary text.
